simple.summary: מָדַי (Mâday) means Median. First listed occurrence: Dan 6 1.

definitions.full: H4077. Maday מדיא Kt, מָדָאָה Qr (K § 61, 6 ) name, of a people Mede ; — Dan 6:1 . [ מְדִינָה ] see דין . [ מְדָר ] see דוד .
